# Third-party dependencies

The experiment adapters call external projects; they do not redistribute
those projects. Install compatible upstream versions separately and follow
their licenses:

- Diffusion Policy: `third_party/DIFFUSION_POLICY_LICENSE`
- robomimic: `third_party/ROBOMIMIC_LICENSE`
- ACT: obtain the upstream repository and follow its license and citation
  requirements.
- RoboSuite and PyTorch: install from their official distributions.

The adapters in this repository are source-only fixed-budget adaptations. They
are not full official reproductions of every upstream training schedule.
